# Woodex Interior

> Woodex Interior is a Lahore design-and-build studio founded in 2016 by Imtiaz Ahmad. It provides interior design, fit-out, renovation, architecture, 3D visualization and custom furniture for homes, offices, retail, restaurants and healthcare across Pakistan, with 200+ completed spaces.

Key facts:
- Address: M-71, Zainab Tower, Model Town Link Road, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 322 4000768 · Email: info@woodex.com.pk
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:30–18:30, Sunday closed
- In-house 3D studio: photoreal 4K renders, 2 revision rounds
- Pricing: quoted in writing after a site visit or brief

## Main services
- [3D Visualization Lahore](https://woodex.com.pk/3d-visualization/): 3D visualization in Lahore: photoreal interior and exterior renders, walkthroughs and virtual tours from the in-house Woodex 3D studio.
- [Architecture Services Lahore](https://woodex.com.pk/architecture/): Architecture services in Lahore for house design, commercial buildings, front elevations and master planning, from concept to construction-ready drawings.
- [Fit-Out Company Lahore](https://woodex.com.pk/fit-out/): Fit out in Lahore for offices, restaurants, retail, healthcare and commercial spaces: design, MEP coordination, joinery and handover by Woodex.
- [Interior Design Lahore](https://woodex.com.pk/interior-design/): Interior design in Lahore for kitchens, bedrooms, living rooms, offices and complete homes. Layouts, materials and 3D views by Woodex Interior.
- [Renovation Company Lahore](https://woodex.com.pk/renovation/): Renovation company in Lahore for homes, offices, retail, healthcare and restaurants: survey, design, phased works and handover by Woodex Interior.
- [Turnkey Interior Design & Build Lahore](https://woodex.com.pk/turnkey-design-build/): Turnkey interior design and build in Lahore with design, construction, furniture and handover under one contract. PKR 9M–28M for a 2,000 sq. ft. benchmark.
